args.name: prepare-and-dry-food-trial
args.function: Enable a small controlled trial of preparing and drying owned roots or berries, with actual observations that distinguish water loss from spoilage and compare against an untreated control.
args.conditions: Whole-root air exposure produced identical decay to a carried control over 8 rounds. No preservation benefit or safety was demonstrated. Any preparation must require an actually suitable tool and surface; neither is currently established. Learning must take world time.
args.inputs: Owned food and an optional same-stack control; real suitable tools, support and other materials if necessary. Exact prerequisites and method remain unknown. Do not supply free equipment or assume sharp stone is already available.
args.costs: Unknown: specify study time, work duration, energy, material use, and interruption or cancellation rules before use. Measurements must require actual paid work where appropriate.
args.effects: Permit only physically supported preparation, drying and inspection under actual weather or heat. Record measured quantities and relevant changes without resetting decay or declaring food safe. No guaranteed preservation, invented resources, automatic mastery or reward. Return a usable contract or explain missing prerequisites.

records.access: Stable600-code-unit pages, zero-based part; concatenate all parts before parsing. Use the same exact id for continuation.

preservationPhysics.initialization: Version-1 berry/root water fraction is a physical-model assumption, not measured evidence.
preservationPhysics.condition: Exact water and nutrient/toxin totals are physical audit state; paid evidence is recorded separately.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own food on open ground or an existing food surface to expose them to actual weather, optionally keeping a carried control from the same stack; inspect both decay trajectories; stop the trial.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Start: inputStackId is the exact id of your own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented); quantity whole units to expose; optional controlQuantity whole units of the same stack kept carried and reserved (together at most its whole units). Place at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your body radius, or on supportId, an existing food surface in reach. One round and 1 + 0.5 x quantity energy; all checks run before any charge; walking there is a separate navigate. Inspect: your open trial, within reach of the batch; one round, 0.2 energy. Stop: one round, no energy. Taking the food back uses pickup at its own cost. No tool, fuel, cutting or material is used or made.
candidates.effects: Start separates the units and lays them, unowned, on a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit (firm ordinary ground inside the world, not water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, nothing else lying there) or on the support, and gives them the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85). Every later round the existing rules apply: whole food loses no water; rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset. The control ages normally while carried. So no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached: they stay unverified; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Anyone may pick up food lying in the world: taking part reduces the batch, taking all ends the trial. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now and per round for batch and control, their difference and rain on the batch, as an unverified personal record; water content is not measured. Spoilage under the existing rule or removal ends the trial; stop ends it and leaves the batch where it lies. Ending releases the control once; death ends it the same way. No refund, reward or comfort.
